_about: Template v2.4 check 16 (scripts/check_handoffs.cjs). Steps that open a PR, merge, push or add a label with GITHUB_TOKEN and do NOT end in `gh workflow run` / repository_dispatch, because no workflow has to start from them. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that matches nothing fails the check.

allow.reason: Report issue for people and agents to read. No workflow has to react to its labels; the dashboard web page (dashboard.yml) picks it up on its 15-minute run.
